title: Lee Clark Allen drops a groove with a healing mission on “Therapy”
htmlContent: Lee Clark Allen’s latest single, “Therapy,” hits harder than expected. With a groove that feels like it belongs in a packed retro-futuristic disco and lyrics that speak directly to the soul, Allen manages to make a party track that’s deeply personal and unafraid to confront mental health head-on. “Therapy” commands attention. The track pulses with a fresh, funky vibe, blending edgy production with raw, heartfelt delivery. Allen pulls you onto a dance floor that doesn’t shy away from emotional truth. “Therapy” is alive, colorful, and unmistakably fun. It walks the bold line between light and dark, joy and struggle. This duality is Allen’s magic, you’re grooving, you’re smiling, and then you realize the lyrics are a mirror reflecting your own battles or those of someone you love. And suddenly, you’re dancing through the pain instead of around it. The single serves as a taste of Allen’s upcoming debut album; if “Therapy” is any indication, it will offer a lens into not just his world but ours too. His approach is fearless. He shares his struggles, offering his voice as a bridge for anyone who’s ever felt overwhelmed by life’s mental twists. https://open.spotify.com/track/4NrgbXky2npWqJhbzLoDl7 What makes “Therapy” stand out is the honesty. There’s something raw and unpolished in the best way, as if Allen made this track in one honest burst of clarity and said, “Here. Let’s feel this together.” In a world where pop often plays it safe, Lee Clark Allen leans in, giving us something different, authentic, and necessary. “Therapy” is a statement. It tells us it’s okay to not be okay, and it does so while making us move.
